profile.summary: The All Stars Project is a nonprofit that runs performance-based youth development programs for young people from poor and underserved communities. Its programs include the Development School for Youth, the All Stars Talent Show Network and the Performance Lab. It is headquartered in New York and also operates in New Jersey, Chicago, Dallas and the San Francisco Bay Area.
